mapper.sql: select menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, coalesce(perms,'') as perms, icon, create_time, menu_position from sys_menu
mapper.select: select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.visible, m.status, coalesce(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time, m.menu_position from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = '0' order by m.parent_id asc, m.order_num asc

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.visible, m.status, coalesce(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time, m.menu_position from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.role_id left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = '0' AND ro.status = '0' order by m.parent_id asc, m.order_num asc
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('sys_menu_menu_id_seq'::regclass) as menuId
insert into sys_menu( menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, order_num, path, component, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, remark, create_by, menu_position, create_time )values( #{menuId}, #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{orderNum}, #{path}, #{component}, #{isFrame}, #{isCache}, #{menuType}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{menuPosition}, now() )
